applications.equipment: System Control Cabinet and HMI Local Operation Panel
applications.projectType: Turnkey Electrical Control System (Design, Software, Commissioning), utilizing existing mechanical infrastructure.
features: Smart Start/Stop: One-touch activation with prerequisite diagnostics (oil pressure/temperature) and historical parameter memory.
Online Stepless Speed Regulation: Dynamic speed adjustment for both the main motor (bowl) and secondary motor (scroll/differential).
Adaptive Differential Speed Control: Torque-priority logic that automatically adjusts the secondary motor speed when current limits are exceeded.
Auto CIP (Clean-in-Place): Time-delayed automatic flushing sequence with configurable durations based on bowl RPM (1000-1500r/min).
Safety Interlocks: Emergency stop integration and automatic shutdown protocols for motor overload, high oil temp (>80°C), low oil pressure (<0.7kg/cm), and excessive vibration.
technicalContributions: Consulted with the client to define the upgrade scope, addressing legacy hardware failures and integrating new process demands (online parameter tuning, DCS integration).
Optimized panel design by separating the system control cabinet (relocated to a clean environment) from the local operation panel to mitigate original harsh, acidic, and dusty platform conditions.
Acted as the lead technical bridge between the mechanical OEM and the end-user, refining the control strategy based on complex mechanical load characteristics.
Coordinated BOM, cost estimation, and electrical schematic design.
Managed software programming, system integration, on-site installation, and commissioning schedules.
Successfully delivered SAT, operator training, and finalized standardized project documentation.

Led on-site commissioning and load testing.
Spearheaded the refactoring and updating of PLC/HMI software to accommodate different press tonnage models based on evolving production recipes.
Executed successful FAT/SAT and client training over a 1-year custom equipment validation cycle.

applications.equipment: Servo Drive System (PLC, HMI, Servo Motor, Drive, and Reducer)
applications.projectType: Control & Drive Solution (Software design, configuration, and commissioning).
features: Constant Speed Pulling & Guiding: Synchronized servo pulling to prevent bending, twisting, or breaking of high-temperature extruded aluminum.

Dynamic Parameter Tuning: Online adjustment of pull force, speed, sawing modes (multi-ingot/single-saw), and length presets.
Safety Interlocks: Protections against motor overload/overcurrent, encoder feedback faults, and saw enable errors.
technicalContributions: Assessed existing VFD-based traction systems and proposed a high-precision servo upgrade to meet tighter production tolerances.
Mapped I/O, sequenced logic, and led the selection of PLC, HMI, servo drives, and gear reducers.
Assisted in software configuration and motion control logic.
Led on-site servo tuning, load testing, SAT, and operator training.

applications.unit: Aluminum Melting Furnace Pulse-Jet Baghouse Dust Collector
applications.equipment: Control and Drive System (PLC, HMI, Main Fan VFD)
applications.projectType: Control & Drive Solution (Software design, configuration, and commissioning).
features: Dual Mode Operation: Manual override for all discrete actuators (valves, fans) and fully automated logic linked to process variables (temp, intervals).
Temperature Interlocks & Valve Routing: Automated switching between furnace valves and cold air valves based on inlet temperature thresholds.
Offline Pulse Cycle Cleaning: Highly configurable pulse-jet sequencing (pulse width, interval, cycle count, and bin-to-bin delays).
Smart VFD Fan Control: Automated frequency matching across 4 distinct operational valve states.
Synchronized Ash Discharge: Interlocked discharge and vibration motors operating during bin offline states.
Asset Protection: Filter bag over-temp shutdown and a 5-minute delayed shutdown sequence for main fan cooling.
technicalContributions: Defined the control scope for the complete overhaul of a legacy furnace dust collection system.
Mapped discrete I/O, sequenced logic, and specified PLC, HMI, and VFD hardware.
Independently designed and developed the complete PLC logic and HMI software architecture.
Led on-site commissioning, loop checking, and load testing.
Independently refactored the HMI UI during production downtime to enhance usability without disrupting urgent manufacturing schedules.
